name: @local/dsh-tool-workflow
description: Model-facing workflow tool: run a JavaScript orchestration script over ctx.workflowEngine — local build adding the size guideline, resume_from_run_id, and budget parameters.

changes: sizeGuideline config states the expected agent scale in the tool description and forwards the matching warning threshold to the engine.
resume_from_run_id, budget_tokens, and budget_ms parameters forwarded to the engine on both foreground and background starts.
Honor mandatory Ultracode orchestration, remove contradictory explicit-only guidance, and expose worker_mode for ordinary or persistent linked workers.
PTC workflows default to existing native background jobs even with a dispatch budget; retain explicit short foreground calls and collect completion rather than extending run_code timeouts.
